itemListElement.name: How to Remove Fireflies.ai From Teams, Zoom and Meet in 2026

mainEntity.name: How do I permanently remove Fireflies AI from Microsoft Teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delete or disconnect the Fireflies account that sends the bot, remove fred@fireflies.ai from invites, and have a Teams admin block the app in the Teams admin center under Teams apps, then Manage apps. App blocking alone doesn't always work. Calendar access lets the bot keep joining.

mainEntity.name: How do I kick Fireflies out of a meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the participant list, click the menu next to Fireflies and choose Remove from meeting, or type /ff leave in the meeting chat. Act fast: within the first 3 minutes, Fireflies creates no transcript or notes. In Teams, removing a participant requires host or presenter rights.

mainEntity.name: Why does Fireflies keep joining my Teams meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Someone on the invite connected their calendar to Fireflies with auto-join turned on. Ask the bot's owner to switch auto-join to Only when I invite, or remove fred@fireflies.ai from the invite. With recurring meetings, edit the whole series rather than one occurrence; otherwise Fred will be back the following week.

mainEntity.name: Will removing Fireflies delete the transcript?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the timing. Removed within the first 3 minutes, Fireflies creates no transcript or notes; removed later, the owner may still get notes for the part it recorded. Without attendee agreement, ask the bot's owner to delete those meeting notes.

mainEntity.name: Can I block Fireflies without admin rights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Partly, yes. You can remove it from meetings you organize and set your lobby so only organizers bypass it, which leaves the bot waiting outside for the organizer to simply deny it entry each time. Company-wide blocking, though, still requires a Teams admin.

mainEntity.name: Is Fireflies AI safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fireflies is a legitimate product with enterprise security options, including HIPAA and SSO on its Enterprise plan. The usual complaint is uninvited joining via auto-join, and settings control that.
